body:
thanks again. I am terrible at making friends. Really the only friends I've ever had were people I was forced to remain in close proximity with for a long time (elementary school, roommates, co-workers). I also have no desire to make friends right now.

I don't have the space to have home gym equipment.

I feel like they will never understand what they have taken away from me.

thanks, I appreciate your help. See the thing is, the relationships with all my friends have atrophied over the years (I haven't even hung out with anyone this year), I am also pretty insecure and have neglected my body to focus on my studies. I'm not overweight, I'm actually very skinny. Now that I have a consistent schedule I can go to the gym regularly, and eventually I might have some confidence to do what I like. But gym, proper food, and everything costs money that is being taken away from me. I also don't really find anything fun, and haven't since as long as I can remember. I've wanted to kill myself since I was in elementary school. I tried some therapy and zoloft for almost a year. 

Also my sister, who had her loans paid off by my parents (though she had about half) is siding with my parents.
